Name: Wheat-stubble incorporated fallow
Comments:
Copied from Greenmount (S Qld) on 19 August 2026. Winter wheat crop, disc tillage soon after harvest around November - stubble cover reduced quickly
Simple crop and stubble cover specification

Parameters.Name: RootBioMassToDepthFactor
Parameters.Label: Root Depth Multiplier
Parameters.Description:
To scale root depth data.
Can be used to quickly change a vegetation specification based on soil and vegetation properties  Suggested Values: 1 unless special information on rooting depth

Parameters.Name: DaysPlantingToHarvest
Parameters.Label: Days plant to harvest
Parameters.Description: Yield based on accumulated dry matter and harvest index between plant date and harvest date Suggested Values: 100 days for fast crop (millet) to 18,250 days (50 years) for a plantation

Parameters.Name: GreenBioMassToCoverFactor
Parameters.Label: Green Cover Multiplier
Parameters.Description: To scale green cover input data. This parameter has a dual purpose. When “Cover Input Options” are set to “user-defined”, it is a linear scaling (calibration/adjustment factor). When set to “From data file”, it is a conversion factor to convert green biomass (kg/ha) into % cover.  Suggested Values: When dealing with cover, this value will be close to 1. When dealing with biomass, it will be equal to whatever is required to convert biomass to %cover. "

Parameters.Name: SWPropForNoStress
Parameters.Label: PAW no crop stress
Parameters.Description: Proportion profile PAW where transpiration is not limited. Suggested Values: Default value 0.3 - as high as 0.8

Parameters.Name: ResidueBioMassToCoverFactor
Parameters.Label: Residue Cover Multiplier
Parameters.Description:
To scale residue cover data. 
This parameter has a dual purpose. When “Cover Input Options” are set to “user-defined”, it is a linear scalar. When set to “From data file”, it is a conversion factor to convert green biomass (kg/ha) into % cover.  Suggested Values: when dealing with cover, this value will be close to 1. When dealing with biomass, it will be equal to whatever is required to convert biomass to %cover. "

Parameters.Name: LinkToGreenCover
Parameters.Label: Green Biomass Time-series
Parameters.Description: Name of the green biomass time series listed in the data file selected in “Source Data”.  Suggested Values: Pick the green biomass one.

Parameters.Name: WaterUseEffic
Parameters.Label: Transpiration efficiency
Parameters.Description:
Dry matter production (kg/ha) per mm transpiration
Estimate dry matter from transpiration.  Suggested Values: 10 to 25 kg/ha/mm for grain crops.  Larger values indicate more efficient water use.

Parameters.Name: PanPlantDay
Parameters.Label: Plant day
Parameters.Description:
Required to estimate yield based on transpiration (TUE) >>dry matter accumulation  >> yield (HI) Suggested Values: 1 June            150
1 November  304

Parameters.Name: MaxAllowTotalCover
Parameters.Label: Max Cover multiplier
Parameters.Description:
Adjust cover for impacts such as trampling. Not normally used 
Default value 1

Parameters.Name: LinkToResidueCover
Parameters.Label: Residue Biomass Time-series
Parameters.Description: Name of the residue biomass time series listed in the data file selected in “Source Data”.  Suggested Values: Pick the residue biomass one.

Parameters.Name: CoverInputOptions
Parameters.Label: Cover Options
Parameters.Description: Cover time series entered here (User-defined) or linked to a datafile. Suggested Values: “user-defined” – “From data file” is meant for DairyMod users.

Parameters.Name: LinkToRootDepth
Parameters.Label: Root depth time series
Parameters.Description: Name of the root biomass time series listed in the data file selected in “Source Data”. Suggested Values: Pick the root biomass one.

Parameters.Name: CropFactorMatrix
Parameters.Label: Cover, residue & roots
Parameters.Description: “Green Cover”  linked to “Green Cover (%)”, “Residue Cover (%)” and “Root Depth (mm)”. Each  data  line associated with a unique day number (Julian days).

Parameters.Name: PanHarvestIndex
Parameters.Label: Harvest index
Parameters.Description:
Estimate yield based on accumulated dry matter
Product biomass (kg/ha) divided by above-ground biomass (kg/ha). 
Transpiration > biomass accumulation (via TUE) > yield (via HI) Suggested Values: Canola  0.3, wheat  0.4, sorghum  0.5, rice  0.5
Lower values for pulses, oilseeds
